features.feature: One byte-identical canonical Finding triage contract is delivered exactly once to all five active REVIEW lanes in both full-envelope and legacy-full-context modes.
features.source: Story acceptance; prompt consolidation and role modularization plans

features.feature: The contract keeps evidenceState, severity, applicability candidate, disposition, and gate impact independent; unknown or stale applicability fails closed; disproven, duplicate, and not_reproduced_under_current_witness remain distinct; future defer_with_proof is limited to eligible verified applicable low or medium Findings.
features.source: Dynamic Finding authority plan plus accepted SEP-B-9a49-001 terminology migration

features.feature: Current compatibility paths remain bounded: finding_dismiss is temporary round or profile accounting only, gap_log remains a main-Agent or human Proof-or-Stop framework-gap archive, and neither path proves applicability, repair, or resolution.
features.source: Triage proposal and role-separation authority boundary

features.feature: Story Owner, implementer, and reviewer responsibilities are separated: reviewers classify and record, owners decide bounded disposition, and implementers preserve evidence and do not widen scope unilaterally.
features.source: role-separation.md and prompt consolidation role contracts

features.feature: Declarative REVIEW triage metadata is restricted to active REVIEW roles and remains non-evidentiary; prompt prose does not redefine schemas, predicates, freshness, supersession, process facts, or lifecycle gates.
features.source: Agent/System two-layer boundary in governing prompt plans

features.feature: RED then GREEN verification covers semantic bite, five-role and two-mode delivery, non-REVIEW isolation, stale-envelope redispatch, digest and baseline integrity, and a full Task Context authority-injection rejection independent of repinned digests.

The open-source proposal remains English-only and the authoritative Dynamic Finding plan receives only the approved documentation migration: canonical target vocabulary, explicitly legacy input alias, and an explicit statement that current CLI implements neither alias normalization nor signed deferral.
features.source: Current INIT scope boundary and accepted SEP-B-9a49-001

features.feature: Existing process-fact producer and consumer references reconcile through the authoritative process-fact registry in the coverage-basis reader without fabricated planned declarations, topology-validator edits, or weaker structural closure.

The pre-review smoke resolves Codex prompt assets canonical-first through accepted adapter directory names, retains deprecated read fallback, and fails closed when both roots are absent without creating a compatibility copy or symlink.

Dynamic Finding runtime schemas, applicability writers, signed deferral handlers or commands, blocker predicates, freshness and supersession consumers, process-fact registries, and lifecycle gates are not implemented by this Story.
features.excluded_by: Current INIT scope boundary; CHK-001; CHK-004

features.feature: The REVIEW triage contract is not injected into active non-REVIEW, compatibility, or retired roles.
features.source: Role registry and five-lane rollout boundary

features.feature: No remote feature branch, push, or alternative delivery workflow is introduced.
Unrelated non-blocking defects are not absorbed merely to make all checks green; they remain evidence-backed follow-up work unless current acceptance or gate truth is blocked.
